hero.title: Connecting the global Chinese HCI community
hero.subtitle: The International Chinese Association of Computer Human Interaction advances cross-cultural research and exchange in human–computer interaction, bringing together scholars, designers and practitioners worldwide.

about.title: A global community for human-centered computing
about.summary: ICACHI was founded on May 10, 2012 in Austin, USA during the ACM CHI conference. Its board comprises overseas Chinese HCI researchers active across the world, building bridges between academia, industry, and education.

conferences.title: ICACHI annual conferences
conferences.subtitle: Since 2013, the association has hosted an annual academic conference in rotating cities around the world — twelve editions and counting.
